searches.mechanism: Archive-pinned local rg search and direct declaration/body inspection
searches.query: Two-dimensional cycle-pair mean ratio and pooled/batched/deleted empirical measures; inspected coordinate expectations and weighted atomic measure constructions.
searches.result: Two coordinate integrals and division define the ratio when the expected duration is positive, and weighted point masses form the empirical substitutions on cycle pairs. The generic CI formulas can then be applied to that functional.

library_audit.gap: These operations suffice to define the cycle-pair functional and empirical substitutions on the positive expected-duration domain.

variant_reviews.comparison: Supply f derivatives through order three and original X_1 cumulants through order four, then simulate K new iid Gaussian vectors with mean zero and original centered covariance Sigma, set A_0 to their mean and B_i=X_i-A_0; the reused X_i notation does not assert Gaussian original observations, and centering the fresh draws makes the B_i dependent rather than another iid family.

searches.mechanism: Archive-pinned local rg search and direct declaration/body inspection
searches.query: Coverage-coefficient simulation initialization with original-law cumulants and fresh correlated Gaussian vectors; inspected iterated derivatives, centered covariance, multivariate Gaussian law, finite products and averages, and searched cumulant-generating infrastructure.
searches.result: The derivatives and centered covariance are representable, and a finite product of N(0,Sigma) laws describes the fresh iid simulation. Low-order original cumulants can be built from mixed moments; an analytic MGF assumption would be stronger than the fourth-moment hypothesis and cannot be inferred here.

library_audit.gap: The initialization still needs the original-law cumulant tensors and statistic input assembled with the Gaussian simulation, without asserting validity or unbiasedness of the later printed algorithm.
